response: I have resolved the issue by updating Django's MySQL backend to use the preferred `"database"` and `"password"` keyword arguments when establishing connection parameters in [`django/db/backends/mysql/base.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-49n881rj/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py#L202-L206) instead of the deprecated `"db"` and `"passwd"`. Additionally, [`django/db/backends/mysql/client.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-49n881rj/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py#L11-L14) was updated to support looking up the `"database"` key from options for dbshell.
